scope: Exact source and analytical premises of DEC-20261102-592897. Unsigned handwritten analytical attestations only; no Lean proof, signed verdict, solving-degree or SAT cost claim.
statement: For every prime p>3 and the reviewed finite-k2 constant-B chart over F_p, with all auxiliary rows retained and x^p-x adjoined for every variable, let C=F_p[z]/K be the auxiliary highest-part quotient. If C is nonzero and target ordinate b is nonzero, append R=N1+2*a*N2 and substitute only A0=b-a*q. Original highest-part regularity is d+2 and reduced regularity is e+1, where d=top(C), e=top(C/(u0+a*u1)^2)<=d, so the drop is at least one. q remains projected; reconstruction preserves full field solutions and corresponding auxiliary fibers.
